## Store compliance

 Single purpose: hiding sensitive content on screen during demos, recordings, and screen sharing
 No data sold, ever
 Third parties: Creem (payments) and Cloudflare (hosting the licence service). Analytics is self-hosted and shared with nobody.
 Everything in transit is encrypted with HTTPS

## Changes to this policy

We update this policy as DataBlur changes. The effective date at the top always reflects the current version, and significant changes are noted in the extension release notes.

## Contact

Questions, privacy requests, or abuse reports:support@datablur.app

See also our Terms of Service. [...] ### The website

datablur.app uses the same self-hosted analytics. If you install the extension after visiting the site, the site can pass its random ID to the extension so we can tell that the install came from the site. This only happens on datablur.app and the extension verifies the origin before accepting it.

Analytics events are only transmitted from released builds. Development builds never send anything.

## Payments

DataBlur Pro is sold through Creem, which acts as the Merchant of Record. Creem processes your payment, handles tax, and issues your invoice under its own privacy policy. We never see or store your card details. Your purchase email is stored locally in the extension only to prefill the restore and billing forms.

 We never sell your data. Not now, not later.

VS. Cloud-Based Screen Protection  
✗ Uploads your screen to external servers  
✗ Privacy concerns  
✗ Requires an internet connection  
✓ DataBlur: 100% local screen blur, complete privacy control, works offline  
  
PRIVACY COMMITMENT  
  
Your privacy is our priority:  
• All blur operations run locally in your browser  
• Zero cloud uploads or external services  
• No account creation or personal information required  
• No mandatory data collection  
• Optional anonymous analytics (can be disabled)  
• Transparent 90-day data retention policy  
• GDPR compliant  
  
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS  
  
• Works on: Chrome, Edge, Brave, and all Chromium browsers  
• Performance: blur creation in under 50 ms  
• Storage: secure browser storage API [...] BLUR YOUR SCREEN. PROTECT YOUR PRIVACY. SHOW REAL WORK SAFELY.  
  
DataBlur is a screen blur extension that eliminates "demo anxiety": it blurs sensitive information during screen shares and recordings — in real time, locally, and in one click. No more fake data. No more hours of video editing. No more worrying about accidental leaks.  
  
Perfect for consultants, sales engineers, content creators, and anyone who presents real data on live calls or in recorded tutorials.  
  
WHAT DATABLUR DOES  
  
Blur your screen and protect sensitive information during:  
• Live screen shares (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Discord)  
• Screen recordings (Loom, OBS, QuickTime, any recording tool)  
• Tutorial creation & course recording  
• Client presentations & demos [...] Your blur preferences save automatically and persist across sessions.  
  
SUPPORT & FEEDBACK  
  
Need help or have a feature request?  
• Email: support@datablur.app  
• Report issues: open the extension popup → "Contact support"  
• Feature requests: we actively incorporate user feedback  
  
TRUSTED BY PROFESSIONALS  
  
Join thousands of consultants, sales engineers, and content creators who present with confidence using DataBlur.  
  
DATABLUR: Present real data. Blur what's sensitive. Eliminate demo anxiety.  
  
Install now and blur your screen in one click.
